24.why: EqExpander.cpp:113 reads one channel per track with getVoltage and EqMaster.cpp:790 puts that voltage through a rise-and-fall trigger that turns on at 1V

25.why: EqExpander.cpp:114 reads one channel per group or aux with getVoltage and EqMaster.cpp:790 puts that voltage through a rise-and-fall trigger that turns on at 1V

comment: A track CV cable carries sixteen channels in fours, one four per band from LF up to HF: band active, frequency, gain and Q. The active channel is read as a gate at 1V, the other three as values, so no one span covers the whole cable.
